entries.not_relevant_because: Neither manuscript treats the canonical bundle of a klt projective variety. The SYZ manuscript (The-Strong-Hyperkahler-SYZ-Conjecture-September-23-2026) proves that a nonzero nef isotropic line bundle on a compact IHS Kähler manifold is semiample; on such manifolds Kₓ is trivial and c₁(L) ≠ 0 excludes it, so the abundance hypothesis is never instanced. The projective-space manuscript (Projective-Space-Bases-of-Lagrangian-Fibrations-September-23-2026) proves the base of a projective Lagrangian fibration is ℙⁿ, uses -K_B ample only as background, and claims nothing about nef canonical bundles or semiampleness of K. The matching pass's 'abundance-type' label reflects only the shared pattern 'nef implies semiample'; the SYZ bibliography entry titled 'The abundance and SYZ conjectures in families of hyperkähler manifolds' is a citation of a different result, not a claim here.
